null_ff_125.name: null_ff_125
null_ff_125.settling_definition: Frame1 idle: all16 bottoms within0.25LSB of actual assigned VREF rail and remain until next sample minus20ps; bit7 N->high/P->low, other bits opposite. Not just RST_DONE.
null_ff_125.coverage: 2670 pairs on445 selected MOS; other blocks and unsaved MOS not fully qualified; helper has ideal supplies/control.
null_ff_125.current_definition: 50ohm reference-source current includes decap charging; helper branch current computed from verified VA conductance equation.

phase_definition: sample: SAMPLE_INT>0.495; conversion: SAMPLE_INT<=0.495 and ACTIVE>0.495; idle: SAMPLE_INT<=0.495 and PRESET>0.495. SAMPLE_INT is request, not Bootstrap SEQ_SAMPLE. Actual sample edges/margins use SEQ_SAMPLE.
null_comparison_bound: Peak20uV, held-error10uV, sample edges0.1ps vs original native source; instrumented null has additional cross breakpoints. Not a simulator accuracy claim.
